newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC says second half to be better.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC says second half to be better.

text.p: Mining giant WMC Ltd said on Wednesday it saw a markedly better second half result than that reported for the six months ended December 31.
Asked by reporters how the company was performing in the current half compared with the first half, WMC managing director Hugh Morgan told reporters: "Markedly better."
He said he saw higher nickel prices and a more favourable exchange rate, as well as higher production and lower costs.
WMC earlier reported a 46.4 percent fall in net profit to A$96.5 million for the half year to end-December.

"(We see) hopefully higher nickel prices and an exchange rate that's likely to be less, if it continues on that current rate, increased production and lower costs and copper prices have firmed," Morgan told reporters.
However, he said this would be offset by the recent decline in the gold price.
